text: The game begins. Six players sit down at the table: Sonnet, Haiku, Gemma, Sol, Luna, Terra. Nobody knows who the killers are.
Night 1

Night falls on Palermo and everyone closes their eyes. The killers meet in the dark, and the officer is shown one of them. A new day dawns in Palermo. Nobody is out.

Night falls on Palermo and everyone closes their eyes. Not everyone opens them: Sonnet is gone. Sonnet's card stays face down.

Night falls on Palermo and everyone closes their eyes. Not everyone opens them: Terra is gone. Terra's card stays face down.
The game is over. The killers win. The roles were: Sonnet the doctor, Haiku the citizen, Gemma the citizen, Sol the killer, Luna the killer, Terra the officer.

Sol was voted out on day one after stepping in to defend Gemma, and the town only learned he was a killer when his card was revealed. On night two, Sonnet was taken, and Terra, who claimed to be the officer, named Luna as a killer and urged the town to vote her. The town instead voted out Gemma, a citizen, after Haiku and Luna pressed her hard, and that left Terra exposed. Night three took Terra, and the killers Sol and Luna won the game for the killers, with Sonnet the doctor, Haiku and Gemma citizens, and Terra the officer.
